description: The interface is served by our own daemon over http://127.0.0.1:7070, which Tauri treats as a remote origin: without this, every `invoke` from the page is denied and the app reports its own daemon as unreachable. Deliberately narrow — core IPC only, so the page can ask the shell how the sidecar is doing. Spawning it, killing it and installing updates stay with the local origin in `default.json`; a page that talked its way onto this port must not inherit the right to execute anything.
